hypothesis: The categorical structure state of the immediately preceding main-number draw may contain cutoff-safe information about inclusion of main numbers in the next draw. A single fixed Hamming-kernel transition estimator may improve a deterministic three-line disjoint union18 portfolio over the exact geometry-matched null.
feature_source: Previous draw's six main numbers only; bonus numbers are excluded. The state definition is frozen to the existing _state definition in automation/orthogonal_research_v2.py.

consecutive_pair_bin: 2 if two or more consecutive pairs
state_definition.distance: Hamming distance across the four categorical state components.

training_cutoff_rule: For target t, use only main draws 1..t-1. For each historical transition u=2..t-1, use state(draw u-1) as the feature and main(draw u) as the outcome. The target feature is state(draw t-1). Add the target outcome only after scoring target t.

estimator.conditional_count: Weighted count of each main number in historical transition outcomes.
estimator.global_rate: Count of each main number in draws 1..t-1 divided by t-1.

portfolio.line_assignment: Deterministic rank interleaving: line 1 uses ranks 1,4,7,10,13,16; line 2 uses ranks 2,5,8,11,14,17; line 3 uses ranks 3,6,9,12,15,18.
portfolio.geometry: Exactly three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines, union18.

random_comparator.method: For each target, uniformly permute labels 1..45 jointly over the three fixed model lines, preserving three six-number lines, pairwise disjointness, union18, and line incidence geometry.

inference.ci_method: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target differences from the exact geometry-matched union18 null.

prospective_confirmation.readiness_rule: Even if the historical gate passes, do not create STRICT_PASS_READY or release purchase lines until the policy owner formally predeclares the prospective minimum target count and completion rule.

promotion_rule: Evaluate this single preregistered axis once. No variants, threshold changes, or parameter search after observing results. Historical failure remains failure. Historical pass alone cannot create purchase readiness because prospective confirmation is required and currently unspecified.
